item.title: CRM & Deck Construction Management Software
item.description:
750-1500 USD | I need a single, cohesive platform that covers our entire workflow as a specialty deck-building company—from the first phone call right through to the final invoice and 3D render. The build should be web-based (mobile-friendly), modular, and ready to scale as our team grows.
CRM MODULE • Customer database management that keeps every contact, note, file, and photo tied to a household or commercial site. • Lead tracking and follow-up with automated reminders, pipeline stages, and email/SMS touchpoints. • Sales reporting and analytics that break down close rates, average deal size, and marketing source ROI at a glance.
CONSTRUCTION MANAGEMENT MODULE • Project scheduling and tracking with a drag-and-drop Gantt or calendar view, task dependencies, and change-order logging. • Resource allocation and management so crews, equipment, and materials are booked without double-ups. • Budget and expense tracking that compares estimated vs. actual costs in real time and pushes data to QuickBooks or Xero.
DECK DESIGN MODULE • 3D modeling and visualization that lets us place a deck onto a photo or lot plan and spin it interactively for clients. • Material cost estimation that auto-updates as dimensions change, pulling live lumber and hardware prices via API when possible. • Blueprint and layout creation that produces permit-ready PDFs with footing locations, beam spans, and hardware callouts.
Technology is flexible, but I’m leaning toward a modern JavaScript stack (React/Vue front-end, Node.js or Django back-end) with a PostgreSQL database and REST/GraphQL API so we can eventually integrate with Zapier, Slack, and our accounting software.
ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA 1. A working SaaS-style MVP deployed to a cloud host (AWS, Azure, or GCP) with separate environments for staging and production. 2. Source code in a private Git repo with clear README and setup scripts. 3. User roles: admin, sales, project manager, design technician, and client portal login. 4. Demonstration data loaded so we can run end-to-end tests: create a lead, convert to project, design deck, schedule crew, track costs, and generate a sales report. 5. Fully responsive UI and cross-browser compatibility (Chrome, Edge, Safari, Firefox latest versions).
Please outline your proposed tech stack, timeline, and any similar projects you’ve shipped. If you already have a deck-design engine or CRM framework that can be customized, highlight that—speed to market matters.

You’ll work directly with me, share progress screenshots or live links as you go, and we’ll iterate quickly until it’s right. Final deliverables are the editable design files and the working front-end code ready to upload to my hosting.
If this sounds like a small, neat project you’d like to jump on, send a short note and a couple of samples that show you can own both design and lightweight development.

item.title: WooCommerce Coupon & Discount Setup
item.description:
3000-5000 EUR | I’m ready to roll out a full-featured discount engine in my WooCommerce store and need an experienced developer to configure it from end to end.
Scope of work – Automatic tiered discounts (e.g., 10 % off orders above $100, scalable to any threshold I define) – “Buy 1, get 1 50 %” and similar mix-and-match promos that trigger correctly in the cart – Visible badges on every product card such as “–20 %”, “Sale”, “Best Seller” so shoppers instantly see the offer – Coupon management: promo codes I can create on demand, first-order incentives, and countdown-based flash deals – Seamless promo-code input field on the cart page with real-time validation – Dedicated “Sale” archive that automatically pulls every discounted item – Countdown timer component for limited-time promotions, adaptable to any campaign length
Please include in your proposal: • A short outline of the plugins or custom code approach you recommend (e.g., WooCommerce Dynamic Pricing & Discounts, Advanced Coupons, custom snippets) and why they fit best • Your estimated timeline with key milestones • A ballpark cost broken down by setup, testing, and launch support
All pricing rules, discount percentages, and creative assets will be supplied by me. I just need a reliable build, clean configuration, and clear hand-off instructions so I can manage future campaigns without developer intervention.

item.title: # WordPress Drone Photography & Videography Website — Mechanicsville Aerial - Fully Hosted and Ready to Launch -- 2
item.description:
30-250 USD | PROJECT: WordPress Drone Photography Website — Mechanicsville Aerial
PROJECT OVERVIEW
I need a professional, fully functional WordPress website for Mechanicsville Aerial, my drone photography and videography business located in Mechanicsville, Virginia.
I own MECHANICSVILLEAERIAL.COM and its associated email domain. The website must be fully built, hosted, tested, and live on my domain before final delivery so I can launch immediately.
The website will showcase my aerial photography and video work and generate customer inquiries and quote requests. Online payments are not required initially, but the website must support adding payment functionality in the future.
I have already paid for a confidentiality agreement. The developer must honor its terms and protect my business information, media, and project materials.
1. WEBSITE DESIGN
Create a modern, professional, mobile-friendly website that works well on computers, tablets, and smartphones.
Include: - Home page - Photography gallery - Video gallery - Services page - Request a Quote / Check Availability page - About page - Contact page - Privacy policy and other necessary standard pages
The design should emphasize attractive aerial imagery, simple navigation, fast loading, and clear calls to action.
2. PHOTOGRAPHY AND VIDEO
The website must accommodate at least 200 photographs, with original files potentially 48 MB each, and at least 75 video clips approximately eight seconds long.
Provide sufficient storage, bandwidth, backups, and efficient media delivery. Use optimized images, thumbnails, and compressed video previews to maintain performance while preserving my original high-resolution files.
The site must support adding more media over time. Explain storage limits, video hosting arrangements, bandwidth limitations, and any additional charges. I must retain control of my original media and any third-party hosting accounts.
3. EASY ADMINISTRATION
I must be able to manage the website without programming knowledge.
Provide a simple WordPress administration interface that allows me to: - Upload, publish, replace, and delete photographs and videos. - Organize galleries into categories. - Edit page content, services, and contact information. - Manage quote requests and customer inquiries. - View and manage email subscribers.
Provide written instructions or a short tutorial showing me how to perform these tasks.
4. QUOTE REQUESTS AND CUSTOMER COMMUNICATION
Visitors must be able to inquire about drone photography and videography services and request pricing or availability.
The form should collect name, email, optional phone number, requested service, project location, preferred date, and project details.
When a request is submitted: - I receive an email notification at my designated business email. - The customer receives an automatic acknowledgment. - The inquiry is saved securely in WordPress. - I can review and track inquiries through the administration area. - I can respond to customers through the website's administration interface using integrated email functionality. - I can review previous inquiries and responses.
Include spam protection and test all functions before launch.
5. EMAIL COLLECTION AND MARKETING
Include an optional newsletter signup form to collect email addresses from prospective customers and existing customers who want business updates.
Provide subscriber management, exportable email lists, appropriate consent language, and unsubscribe functionality. Quote requests must not automatically enroll customers in marketing emails without appropriate consent.
Identify any additional email marketing service fees.
6. BUSINESS EMAIL AND DOMAIN
Configure the website to work with my existing MECHANICSVILLEAERIAL.COM domain and professional email.
Integrate my current email provider where possible, or recommend an appropriate business email service. Configure and test email delivery, including SPF, DKIM, and DMARC records where applicable.
Test inquiry notifications, customer acknowledgments, and replies.
My domain and existing email accounts must remain under my control. Do not transfer, cancel, or disrupt existing services without my approval.
7. SEO AND SOCIAL MEDIA
Implement sound technical, on-page, and local SEO practices to help attract customers in Mechanicsville, Richmond, Hanover County, and surrounding Virginia communities.
Include: - Search-friendly page titles, descriptions, headings, and URLs. - XML sitemap and descriptive image alt text. - Mobile optimization and good page performance. - Appropriate local business structured data. - Google Search Console and analytics integration where available. - Social media sharing links and attractive previews. - Clear quote-request calls to action.
Use relevant terms naturally, including drone photography, aerial photography, drone videography, real estate aerial photography, and Mechanicsville, Virginia.
Optimize the website for search visibility and social sharing. No guaranteed search rankings or social media exposure are expected.
8. FUTURE ONLINE PAYMENTS
Online payments are not required at launch. However, use a maintainable WordPress architecture that will allow a secure payment gateway and future service deposits or payments to be added without rebuilding the website.
Do not activate paid payment services without my approval.
9. HOSTING, SECURITY, AND LAUNCH
This is a turnkey project. I require a fully functional, hosted website live on MECHANICSVILLEAERIAL.COM before final acceptance, not merely website files or a design.
The developer must: - Configure suitable WordPress hosting, domain connection, and SSL/HTTPS. - Install and configure WordPress, the theme, and necessary plugins. - Implement appropriate security and automated backups. - Configure email and inquiry notifications. - Test the website on desktop and mobile devices. - Test galleries, video playback, forms, and email communication. - Deliver a complete website backup and restoration instructions. - Provide administrator access and operating instructions. - Identify all paid themes, plugins, licenses, hosting plans, and recurring charges.
Disclose all ongoing costs and hosting limitations before work begins.
10. OWNERSHIP AND CONFIDENTIALITY
I require full ownership and administrative control of the completed website and all deliverables, subject to applicable third-party licenses and the project agreement.
The domain must remain in my account. Hosting and related accounts must be registered in my name or transferred to my control.
Upon final payment, provide: - Complete WordPress website files and database. - Custom graphics and assets created for the project. - Administrator credentials and access to relevant accounts. - A complete downloadable website backup. - Operating and restoration instructions. - A list of plugins, themes, licenses, subscriptions, and renewal costs. - The agreed ownership and usage rights for custom work.
I must be able to hire another developer without being locked into proprietary arrangements. Do not retain exclusive control over the domain, hosting, website, or customer information. Honor the existing confidentiality agreement.
11. ACCEPTANCE REQUIREMENTS
The project is complete only when the website is live, functional, and under my control.
Before final acceptance, demonstrate that: 1. The domain opens securely. 2. Photo galleries and videos work. 3. I can add and remove media without programming. 4. Quote requests are stored and email notifications work. 5. I can respond to customers through the website administration interface. 6. Email collection, consent, and unsubscribe functions work. 7. Business email integration is tested. 8. SEO basics and social sharing previews are configured. 9. Backups, documentation, and administrator access are delivered. 10. Storage limits, ongoing expenses, and licenses are documented. 11. Ownership and confidentiality requirements are satisfied.
Please provide a fixed-price proposal, estimated delivery schedule, hosting recommendations, recurring costs, and a list of included and excluded features. Identify limitations before work begins.
The final product must be a professional, fully operational WordPress website, hosted and ready for immediate launch, with room for future growth.

item.title: Minimalist Journal Purchase Site
item.description:

Purchase Flow The checkout page must integrate a payment gateway of your choice (Stripe or PayPal are both fine), allow shoppers to add the journal to a lightweight cart, and trigger an automatic confirmation email once the transaction succeeds. Everything should sit behind HTTPS, respond smoothly on mobile, and be ready for modest traffic from day one.
Branding I’ll supply the palette that ties back to my print packaging. No logo or custom fonts are required—just consistent colours applied thoughtfully.
Deliverables • Two responsive pages (home + purchase) • Integrated payment gateway, cart, and confirmation email configured and tested • Source files and brief hand-over notes so I can update copy or colours later
If this sounds like a quick, tidy build for you, I’m ready to start as soon as we agree on timeline.

item.title: FINRA Exam Page on WordPress
item.description:
250-750 USD | I want a new page built into my existing WordPress site that matches the professional, corporate look of the rest of the platform. The focus of the page is to showcase the FINRA/NASAA practice exams I provide—Series 6, Series 7, Series 63, Series 66, Series 79, and Series 99—together with a bank of 100 interactive questions.
Here’s how I picture it coming together:
• Seamless WordPress integration so the page inherits my current header, footer, and typography. • Clean, corporate-style layout: straightforward typography, restrained color palette, and an intuitive hierarchy that makes the exams the star of the page. • A concise description or card for each listed exam, leading users straight into the interactive quiz experience. • The interactive question component (100 total questions) should provide real-time feedback, tally scores instantly, and be easy for me to update in the dashboard—whether you use a reputable quiz plugin or custom code is up to you, as long as it stays lightweight and secure. • Mobile-first responsiveness, so the questions are just as smooth on a phone as they are on a desktop. • Basic on-page SEO setup: exam-specific headings, meta data, and alt tags baked in.
Once the page is ready, I’ll need a quick hand-off guide or short Loom video showing me how to edit questions or add new ones down the line.
If you’ve built interactive quiz pages in WordPress before and can keep the styling buttoned-up and corporate, I’m ready to move quickly.

item.title: Industrial Construction Site Advisors Needed
item.description:
15-25 USD/hr | I’m building an online platform that will serve industrial constructors across the United States and Canada, yet my own background is rooted in web development, not construction. To keep the content accurate and genuinely useful, I need seasoned industrial constructors to act as subject-matter advisors throughout the build.
Here’s what I’m asking of you:
• Review each major section of the website as it rolls out and flag any gaps or misinterpretations in construction logic. • Recommend the most appropriate materials, codes, and best-practice methods that an industrial contractor would expect to see referenced. • Double-check the project calculators and cost estimators I’m integrating, making sure the formulas and underlying assumptions reflect real-world numbers.
I will provide interactive previews and updated builds so you can navigate the site directly and leave comments in place—no guesswork required. Collaboration will be asynchronous; you can log in, annotate, and send me your notes at your convenience.
Deliverables will be concise review memos or tracked-change documents after each sprint, culminating in a final pass where everything is sanity-checked before launch. Once your feedback has been implemented, we’ll close the loop with a brief confirmation session to ensure the updates meet your professional expectations.
If you’re an industrial constructor with hands-on experience in North American projects and you enjoy shaping tools that make our field more efficient, I’d love to have you on board.

item.title: AI Tools Directory WordPress Site
item.description:
30-250 USD | I want to launch a clean, fast-loading WordPress site that serves as a searchable directory of AI, productivity, business and learning tools, each monetised with affiliate links. I already have hosting in place; you’ll handle the full WordPress installation, set-up and hardening so the project is production-ready from day one.
Because I’m not an interface expert, I’d like you to guide me on the most suitable homepage layout—grid, list, masonry or any hybrid you feel will showcase the tools elegantly on desktop and mobile. I don’t have inspirational examples, so please come prepared with a few modern, minimalist references we can discuss before you dive into design.
Core build requirements • Responsive, minimalist theme or custom child theme • Homepage that surfaces featured or newest tools and encourages exploration • Structured directory with categories, tags and an internal search + filter system • Individual tool review pages with space for screenshots, pros/cons, rating and my affiliate CTA buttons • Blog section for news and tutorials, plus a separate “Frameworks” section (essentially another category template) • Newsletter signup (I’m on Mailchimp but open to better options) placed strategically across the site • Affiliate link management via a reliable plugin or lightweight custom solution • On-page SEO configuration (metadata, schema for reviews, XML sitemap) • Image and code optimisation to keep load times low; aim for green Core Web Vitals • Security best practices (firewall, login protection, automated backups) • Google Analytics 4 (or Matomo if you prefer open-source) fully configured
Deliverables 1. Staging site for approval, then live deployment 2. All page templates, menus and sample content populated so I can see the flow 3. Documentation or short Loom walkthrough covering how I add new tools, blog posts and track affiliate clicks 4. Post-launch support window to tackle any unforeseen bugs
If you have experience building niche directories with affiliate integration and can suggest thoughtful UI/UX improvements, I’d love to hear how you would tackle this from theme selection to performance tuning.
Deliverables: • Fully functioning website on IONOS hosting • Admin access • Ability to add/edit tools without coding PLAN IS TO start with 50 tool reviews, 20 blog posts, and 5 framework articles before launch. That gives the website enough content to look established and begin attracting Google traffic from day one.

item.title: RITHU BUSINASS LANKA SOCIAL MEDIA WEB SIDE -- 2
item.description:
250-750 USD | My brand, Rithu Business Lanka, already has a basic site online (https://rithubusinesslanka.vercel.app/) built with a single Next.js + Node/Express codebase. The core pages load, the UI is responsive, and the backend APIs move data without a hitch—but the site still feels like a brochure. The next milestone is turning it into an engaging hub where visitors stay, talk, and share.
Scope of the upgrade • Add real-time Live Chat so visitors can ask questions while they browse. • Embed Customer Feedback Forms that push data straight into the existing API layer for quick reporting. • Tight Social Media Integrations (Facebook page feed, share buttons, message-me links) to keep our audience inside the brand loop. • A lightweight CMS section for Blog Posts, short Product Updates, and the occasional Video drop, all manageable without redeploying code. • Maintain the unified Next.js frontend and Node/Express backend structure, keeping deployments on Vercel as they are now.
Technical stack in play Next.js (latest LTS), React hooks, Tailwind CSS, Node.js/Express REST API, MongoDB Atlas. Feel free to suggest complementary tools or libraries if they slot smoothly into that ecosystem.
Acceptance criteria 1. Live chat widget shows online/offline status and logs transcripts in MongoDB. 2. Feedback form submissions surface in an admin dashboard with basic filtering. 3. Facebook feed pulls the latest five posts without slowing page load. 4. Blog, video, and product-update entries publish from a simple markdown or WYSIWYG editor and render correctly on the main site. 5. All new pages pass Lighthouse scores of 90+ for performance and accessibility on mobile and desktop.
Push the finished code into the current Git repository, document new environment variables, and supply a brief README so handoff is seamless.

item.title: Squarespace Refresh for DigitalGarage.tv
item.description:

The core identity of the brand must remain intact, so I’ll be re-using all existing logos, copy, imagery and video assets.
Here’s what stays exactly as it is: • Logo and overall branding palette • All written content and supporting text blocks • Our current images and rich-media clips
And here’s what will be rebuilt inside Squarespace’s environment: • Homepage • About Us • Services • Showcase / Portfolio sections • Partners • Support hub • Contact Us with improved forms • Solutions overview • “What We’ve Done” case studies • “What We’re Doing” live projects
The main objective behind the redesign is to generate more leads. To achieve that I need streamlined navigation, clear calls-to-action, mobile-first layouts, and Squarespace’s built-in analytics and SEO tools configured correctly.
Deliverables I’ll accept: • Selection and installation of a clean, white-forward Squarespace template (or custom build of comparable light aesthetic). • Page-by-page layout construction, replicating content while improving hierarchy, layout and readability. • Styling that elevates professionalism—consistent fonts, balanced whitespace, subtle animation where it adds energy. • Lead-capture touchpoints (newsletter, enquiry forms) integrated with my existing CRM or direct email. • Basic on-page SEO setup and performance checks for desktop, tablet and mobile. • Final walkthrough and hand-off so I can update content myself going forward.
If this scope fits your expertise in Squarespace design and you can keep the site lightweight, fast and conversion-focused, I’d love to move ahead quickly.

item.title: Crypto Token Review Portal
item.description:
250-750 USD | I’m building a small, professionally-styled web portal that lets any visitor paste a crypto token’s public contract address, choose its blockchain, and hit “Submit.” Once submitted, the entry must appear instantly inside a private admin dashboard where my team—and, eventually, some AI helpers—can open it, attach or generate a report, and click a single button to return that report to the original requester.
Core flow to implement • Public page: simple form capturing contract address and blockchain. • Admin side: secure login, sortable list of submissions, file-upload or rich-text area for the report, plus a “Send Report” button that emails (or otherwise serves) the result back to the user and marks the request as completed. • Status tracking so the user can see whether their request is “Under Review” or “Report Ready.”
Look & feel I want a clean, professional interface—nothing flashy, just polished and trustworthy. Think clear typography, restrained color palette, quick loading.
Tech & hosting I’m flexible on the stack; suggest what you’re comfortable with as long as it’s easy for me to update later. Security, basic spam protection, and responsive design are expected.
Deliverables 1. Working website (public form + admin portal) deployed to my hosting or a test server. 2. Source code with brief setup instructions. 3. Short hand-off call or document explaining how to approve future submissions.
If this initial build goes smoothly, I’ll return for follow-up features and refinements. Let me know any questions or preferred frameworks, and we’ll get started.

item.title: Interactive Webinar Lottery Platform
item.description:
750-1500 USD | I need a streamlined website that can host my webinars live and then make the replays instantly available in the same space. Visitors will register with their email address only—no social-media logins or guest viewing—so the system must handle account creation, confirmation, and reminder emails automatically. Each item that will be in the webinar will need to have information in the backend (There should be no more than 15 items, 1 of which may be a picture (or link to picture.) When the customer goes into a particular webinar, they will see the number of seats total, number of seats left (unsold) and a list of icons of all the seats. The sold ones should be greyed out and the available ones should be white. There should be a way to list the number of seats and have the display based on that number.
The site I am trying to replicate is https://igy6armory.com/webinar/
During each session I want participants to interact through an on-screen Q&A panel and/or take part in quick polls or surveys that I can launch in real time. At the end of every webinar a built-in lottery draw should randomly select one or more registered attendees and display the winners on screen. The draw must be transparent to the audience and export its results to a simple CSV for my records.
Key deliverables • Responsive website (desktop & mobile) that streams live webinars and hosts recorded replays • Secure email-based registration and login workflow • Moderator dashboard with controls for Q&A, poll creation, and live lottery draw • Attendee view featuring Q&A panel and pop-up polls without requiring page reloads • Automated emails: signup confirmation, reminder, replay link, and winner notification • Basic analytics (attendance count, poll results, engagement stats)
Acceptance criteria 1. Live stream tested with at least 50 simultaneous viewers without lag. 2. Lottery algorithm demonstrably fair (e.g., uses server-time seed and shows audit log). 3. Replay video available within 5 minutes of session end. 4. All emails reach major providers’ inbox (not spam) in test runs.
Feel free to use the framework or stack you’re most comfortable with—WordPress plugins, a custom React front end with WebRTC, or an all-in-one SaaS API—so long as the finished product is easy for me to maintain and brand. I’m ready to move quickly once I see a clear development plan and realistic timeline.

item.title: Construction Website Modernization and Optimization
item.description:
250-750 USD | My construction company’s website still runs on an older codebase, looks dated, and Chrome’s console is full of warnings—mostly script deprecations and Permission-Policy violations. I’m ready to give it a clean, modern and sleek facelift while also fixing every technical issue that slows it down or hurts the mobile experience.
What I need you to do • Audit the existing site, pinpoint every console error, and correct the underlying code or headers so the logs stay clean in Chrome, Firefox, and Edge. • Implement or revise the Permission-Policy header so there are no violations reported. • Redesign the front end with a contemporary, visually tight layout that keeps current content but feels fresh and professional. • Make the layout fully responsive, ensuring smooth behaviour on common breakpoints (mobile, tablet, desktop). • Optimise images, scripts, stylesheets, and server settings so Google PageSpeed Insights comfortably scores in the high 90s on both mobile and desktop. • Hand over a tested, production-ready site along with a brief summary of changes and any new dependencies.
Key notes – Design preference: modern and sleek—think generous white space, strong typography, subtle animation, and a colour palette that conveys trust. – Platform: the existing stack will be shared once you’re onboard; I’m open to fresh tooling if it shortens the build and keeps maintenance simple. – Timeline: ASAP. Please outline how quickly you can start and your estimated turnaround.
If this sounds like the kind of challenge you enjoy, let’s talk timelines and the next steps.

item.title: Wix Dancewear Shop Setup
item.description:

item.title: Custom E-Commerce Site with AliExpress
item.description:
1500-3000 USD | I need a full-featured e-commerce website built from the ground up—no Shopify, no off-the-shelf themes. A completely custom solution will give me the flexibility I need for long-term growth and brand control.
Core requirements • User accounts with secure registration, social login optional, and a simple dashboard for order history and saved items. • Product reviews and star ratings that can be moderated from the admin panel. • Fast, intuitive search with filters (price, category, rating, point value, etc.) and real-time suggestions. • Every product carries a point value that is automatically tallied at checkout; accumulated points serve as entries in an ongoing sweepstakes / prize giveaway, so the cart and account pages must display running totals clearly. • Products are sourced directly from AliExpress. They need to arrive in my catalogue via automated API calls, not manual uploads. The sync should pull images, variations, inventory counts, and pricing, and let me adjust mark-ups before publishing.
Technical expectations The stack is up to you—Laravel, Django, Node.js, or another robust framework—as long as it’s secure, performant, and documented. I’ll need: 1. A RESTful back end, cleanly structured for future mobile-app use. 2. A modern, responsive front end (React, Vue, or standard server-rendered templates—convince me). 3. AliExpress API integration or a reliable custom bridge that fetches, maps, and updates product data on a schedule I can configure. 4. Admin dashboard for catalogue, orders, users, reviews, giveaway points, and basic analytics. 5. Stripe and PayPal payment gateways to start, with room to add Klarna and Apple Pay later. 6. Deployment scripts or Docker setup so I can reproduce the environment on staging and production servers.
Acceptance criteria • Page load under 2 s on desktop (Lighthouse 90+ performance score). • AliExpress product sync runs without manual intervention and logs errors visibly. • Checkout accurately records and displays sweepstakes points. • OWASP top-10 vulnerabilities addressed; user data encrypted in transit and at rest. • Full source code in Git with commit history, plus a brief README for setup and deployment.
If this aligns with your expertise, let’s discuss timeline and phased milestones so we can launch a rock-solid store and scale from there.

item.title: WordPress Malware Cleanup and Migration
item.description:
250-750 AUD | My WordPress site has been compromised: visitors are being redirected to random domains, intrusive pop-ups are appearing, and I’m logging far more failed sign-in attempts than usual. I already have a fresh full backup, so you can work on a copy or restore point right away.
Here’s what I need from you: clean every trace of malware, document what was removed, close the vulnerability that allowed the breach, and then move the site to a new hosting environment without any downtime. Once migration is complete, I’ll want you to verify that the installation is still malware-free, that SSL and permalinks survived the move intact, and that performance hasn’t been impacted.
Experience recovering hacked WordPress installs is essential; your reviews should reflect successful malware removal and post-cleanup hardening. Familiarity with common security plugins, server-side scanning tools, and manual file/database inspection will help you sail through this quickly. Continuous security monitoring setup after the move would be a welcome bonus if you offer it.
Deliverables • Cleaned WordPress core, themes, and plugins with a brief report of actions taken • Hardened configuration (updated salts, strict file permissions, login protections) • Seamless migration to the new server, DNS updated, SSL functioning • Final security scan results and proof that the redirects, pop-ups, and brute-force attempts have stopped
Please outline your approach, estimated timeline, and any post-migration support you include.

item.description: 15-25 USD/hr | Project Title: Build a School Graduation Photography Booking Platform for H Studio Project Description: I’m looking for an experienced web developer to design and build a booking platform for school graduation photography. You will use this HTML as the starting point for the final platform’s design and functionality. Core Features - Responsive website that works smoothly on desktop, tablet, and mobile. - Administrative dashboard for managing bookings and users. - Role-based access with different permissions for administrators and photographers. - Booking history with filters by date, classroom, or activity. - Databases and backend functionality for all forms and workflows. - Automated notifications and messages through WhatsApp Business and email. - Integration of externally hosted photography galleries, each with a unique link and password for the student or family. - Local photo storage for a portfolio showcasing additional services, such as First Communion photography and events. - A structure that supports basic payment gateway integration in the future, if required. What We Will Provide - The desktop HTML prototype, including simulated data and detailed workflow examples. - An Excel database of public and private schools. - A dedicated WhatsApp Business number for H Studio. - A domain registered with GoDaddy. - An external photography gallery provider that generates unique gallery links and passwords. - Legal text for the privacy policy and related pages. Some features still need to be defined or developed in more detail. We expect the selected developer to review the prototype, identify gaps, and help clarify these before implementation. Please Include in Your Proposal - Examples of booking platforms or similar systems you have built. - Your recommended technology stack and hosting approach. - Your estimated timeline and budget. - Any questions, assumptions, or third-party costs, including WhatsApp messaging, email delivery, hosting, and storage. We are looking for someone who can turn the existing prototype into a reliable, secure, and easy-to-use platform.

item.title: AI Platform for Distressed Deals
item.description:
15-25 USD/hr | I’m ready to invest in a custom AI-driven platform that takes a distressed real-estate lead from raw data all the way through a signed purchase agreement—always targeting properties in pre-foreclosure, tax delinquency, or other high-motivation situations so we can acquire them well below market value.
Core capabilities I need • Data ingestion and enrichment: pull fresh owner and property details from public records, mainstream real-estate databases, and any relevant third-party APIs. The system must de-duplicate records, flag high-priority leads, and keep the data refreshed automatically. • Predictive identification: use machine-learning models to score which owners are most likely to accept a discounted cash offer. Transparency on the factors driving each score is important so I can tweak my acquisition criteria. • Multi-channel outreach: once a lead is approved, the platform should launch pre-configured SMS, e-mail, ringless voicemail, and postcard campaigns, then track every touchpoint in one timeline. • Conversation automation: integrate a GPT-style conversational agent that can handle routine seller questions and book calls into my calendar while handing complex threads off to me or my acquisitions manager. • Negotiation & contract workflow: auto-populate offer numbers, generate state-specific purchase agreements, route them for e-signature, and store everything in a secure deal folder. • Deal pipeline dashboard: Kanban or similar view showing lead → offer → under contract → closed, with projected profit and time to close calculations. • Mobile first: a companion app for both iOS and Android so I can review comps, fire off messages, or sign docs on the go.
Acceptance criteria 1. End-to-end demo that starts with raw data import and finishes with a signed test contract. 2. Accuracy metrics for lead scoring and outreach delivery provided in a written report. 3. Source code, model notebooks, and setup scripts delivered in a private repository with clear README. 4. Deployment documents for both cloud hosting and App Store / Play Store submission.
If you have prior experience mingling AI, prop-tech data feeds, and transactional workflows, let’s talk about milestones and timelines—I’m ready to move quickly.

item.title: Comprehensive WordPress Site Overhaul
